basis: Synthetic consistent-unit hand example; no engineering material properties or allowables are inferred.
Coordinates are chosen integers. M=(D+E)/2=(5,9,1); N=(E+F)/2=(9,11,1).
Node labels identify distinct points; API indices are positions in node_order, exported IDs are positions plus one.
Gmsh reference manual, Node ordering, Low order elements: Line 3 is endpoint, endpoint, midpoint; https://gmsh.info/doc/texinfo/gmsh.html#Node-ordering
CalculiX 2.18 manual, Three-node 3D beam element, Figure 73: B32 is endpoint, midpoint, endpoint; https://www.feacluster.com/CalculiX/ccx_2.18/doc/ccx/node60.html
CalculiX 2.18 manual, *BEAM SECTION: RECT dimensions and section/material set references; https://www.feacluster.com/CalculiX/ccx_2.18/doc/ccx/node215.html
RECT dimensions (2,3) and (4,2), elastic pairs (12,1/4) and (24,1/8), and unit Z section direction are arbitrary distinguishing inputs.
Tip force: magnitude 8 times direction (0,-1,0) gives DOF 2 force -8. Root constraint: DOF 1 value 0.
